title: "Daily Translation: Meeting a Friend at a Café"

---

## 中文原文

你周末约了朋友线下见面。你提前出门，搭乘公交前往约定的咖啡馆。路上交通拥堵，比预想花费了更久。等你赶到的时候，朋友已经到了。你们点了两杯饮品，坐下来聊天，分享最近各自工作生活里发生的趣事。

## My translation

I made an appointment with my friend to see each other on weekend.

I left home early to take the bus to the coffee shop.

The traffic was not good, so it took longer time than I expected to get there.

When I arrived, my friend was already there. We ordered two cups of drinks and sat down to chat about interesting things happened in our recent life and work.

## Revised version

I’d arranged to meet a friend on the weekend.

I left home early and took the bus to the café.

There was heavy traffic, so the trip took longer than I’d expected.

When I got there, my friend had already arrived. We ordered two drinks, sat down and chatted about funny things that had been going on in our work and personal lives lately.

## Key phrases

- **arranged to meet**：和朋友约好见面
- **there was heavy traffic**：交通拥堵的常用表达
- **take longer**：*take longer time* 是重复表达
- **had already arrived**：突出在“我”到达之前，朋友已经到了
- **two drinks**：无需再加 *cups*；*cup* 一般与 *tea* 或 *coffee* 搭配
- **funny things that had been going on**：最近发生的趣事
